name: Paradise Valley
why: A palm-lined gorge in the hills behind Agadir, with natural rock pools to swim in, reached by a short path from the road.
book: Free; taxi or tour from Agadir or Taghazout (1 h).
dangers: Do not jump into shallow pools.
Heat from June to September: walk early, carry 2-3 litres.

points.name: Paradise Valley parking
points.note: The car park on the road to Imouzzer.

points.name: Paradise Valley
points.note: Green pools between palms and rocks.
